title: A multidimensional approach to comparative avian visual systems (PhD dissertation, Purdue University)
why: A Purdue University dissertation on comparative avian visual systems (visual fields, retinal topography, acuity); the title with its parenthesis follows the line sweep-3 already holds for it, which says it covers 29 North American species in 14 families with a species list not visible from the abstract. A vesper sparrow is a ground-foraging North American emberizid, so Pooecetes may be among them. It came back for one extra web search worded for emberizid visual fields ("emberizid foragers binocular vision fronto-lateral visual acuity visual fields retinal topography sparrows"). The oa job found no free copy (sources/oa-none-3 and oa-none-7). Not opened. [On main: sources/oa-none-3: no free copy; also wanted by sweep-3, web-birds.]
